text: Hallelu YAH! Praise, O my soul, YHWH!
I will praise YHWH during my life; I will sing praises to my God while I exist.
Do not put your⁺ trust in princes—in a son of man, for in him [is] no deliverance.
His spirit goes forth, he returns to his earth; on that day his plans perish.
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob; his hope [is] upon YHWH his God,
maker of the heavens and the earth, the sea and all that [is] in them, the One guarding truth forever,
doing justice for the oppressed, giving bread to the hungry. YHWH [is] the One freeing those who are bound;
YHWH opens the eyes of the blind; YHWH raises up those bent down; YHWH loves the righteous ones;
YHWH guards the sojourners; the fatherless and widow He sustains, and the way of the wicked He overturns.
YHWH reigns forever—Your God, O Zion, from generation and generation! Praise YAH!
